tool.modulation_classify.description: Modulation classification: complex-baseband instantaneous statistics (amplitude/phase/frequency variance) + spectral features -> top-N candidates with confidence. Sets ambiguous=True instead of silently concluding when candidates are close.
tool.symbol_rate_estimate.description: Blind symbol-rate estimation via spectral-envelope clock-line detection. Returns symbol_rate_hz=None with a reason when the line SNR is insufficient — never reports a false value.
tool.alpha_estimate.description: Raised-cosine rolloff factor estimation: three-segment linear fit of the power spectrum (passband/transition/stopband), cross-validated by width and slope methods; sets ambiguous=True when the two methods disagree significantly.
tool.cma_equalize.description: CMA constant-modulus blind equalization: recovers the constellation over multipath ISI channels without a training sequence (Godard, block-averaged N-CMA). The QAM cost floor is non-zero (16QAM ~0.42); improvement is assessed against that floor, and insufficient improvement or numerical overflow is reported honestly as converged/diverged — no fabricated equalization claims.
tool.nav_bit_sync.description: GPS 50 bps bit synchronization: locate bit boundaries by coherent accumulation and decide bits. Returns in_sync=False with an honest reason when sync evidence is insufficient (low SNR or non-nav stream) — never fabricates synchronization.
tool.subframe_assemble.description: Bit stream to 300-bit subframe sequence with explicit TLM/HOW/parity-chain validation per subframe; trailing partial segments are counted and reported honestly, never silently dropped.
tool.how_validate.description: Per-field TLM/HOW subframe validation: 0x8B preamble, parity chain, SFID range; reports TOW, alert flag and anti-spoof flag.
tool.orbit_propagate_stm_j2.description: ECI two-body + J2 state propagation with 6x6 STM (variational equations integrated jointly; J2 is the dominant LEO perturbation). Excludes atmospheric drag, solar radiation pressure and higher-order zonal terms — an honest capability boundary.
tool.initial_orbit_laplace.description: Laplace angles-only initial orbit determination: three station-centric RA/Dec observations -> ECI state at t2. Multiple solutions reported honestly (n_solutions) with residual RMS in arcseconds; two-body assumption — J2 model error is not hidden within residuals.
tool.frame_layout_spec_load.description: Frame-layout spec loading and structural validation (JSON text/dict; YAML requires PyYAML, with an explicit error when missing). Hard validation: unique field names, non-negative bit offsets, type whitelist.
tool.field_extract.description: MSB-first bit extraction from raw frames per layout spec (uint/int/ascii/bytes + scale/offset/enum). Out-of-range access raises explicit errors; unmatched enum values are preserved honestly as raw values.
tool.crc_check.description: Rocksoft parameterized CRC whole-frame check (configurable poly/init/refin/xorout, any width <= 32 bits); mismatch between computed and embedded value is reported honestly with ok=False.
tool.golden_assert.description: Compare tool results against a golden baseline (dot-path tolerances, NaN neutral on both sides); missing/extra/differing fields are each reported honestly. Golden files are read-only — baseline changes require a human; an agent must never edit the baseline to make regression pass.
tool.df_amplitude_compare.description: Two-channel amplitude-comparison direction finding: invert off-boresight angle from power difference (Gaussian squint beam model or measured calibration table). Model inversion is not a direct measurement; multiple/no solutions and residuals are reported honestly; channel imbalance is calibrated explicitly via offset_db.
tool.jammer_generate.description: Synthetic interference sources (tone/noise/chirp/pulse complex-baseband IQ; parameterized power/frequency/bandwidth/duty, reproducible seed). Synthetic only — never drives transmit hardware; real transmission must go through the TT&C arm_manual human gate.
tool.interference_assess.description: Before/after signal-quality comparison under interference: PSD percentile-based SINAD/signal power/noise floor/occupied bandwidth + degradation in dB (positive = worse). Hard validation of equal-length paired snapshots.
tool.fhss_hop_track.description: Slow-FHSS dwell-frequency tracking (STFT per-slot spectral average, slot-timing-known basis); slots with insufficient prominence are recorded as missed — no fabricated frequencies. Tracked values include modulation offset (2FSK peak at f_h +/- f_dev); dehopping reuses the same values for self-consistent mixing.
tool.dehop_demod.description: Slot-by-slot dehopping against the tracked hop sequence + FM discrimination (missed slots are skipped without interpolation; skipped_slots lists them honestly).
tool.sat_profile_list.description: List all satellite names in the satellite parameter library (a configuration table of frequency / symbol rate / modulation / coding parameters). Swapping satellites or waveforms only swaps the configuration table — zero code changes; this tool is the discovery entry point of the parameter-injection surface. Side effects: read-only. Capability boundary: reads the library only, performs no computation.
tool.sat_profile_load.description: Fetch a satellite parameter profile by name (frequency / symbol rate / modulation / RRC alpha / sampling chain / channel coding), output ready to feed the receiver-chain tools. Precondition: the name must exist in the library (call sat_profile_list first). Failure handling: unknown names error honestly and list the available names (no guessing, no silent fallback). Side effects: read-only.
tool.frame_layout_list.description: List all layout names in the frame-layout library (sync word / field layout / CRC scheme). All in-frame fields (offset / length / type / scale / unit) are injected from the layout table.
tool.frame_layout_load.description: Fetch a frame layout by name (sync word / field layout / CRC), output ready to feed frame-sync / field-extraction / verification-chain tools. Every layout carries an honesty annotation (public standard vs example layout). Failure handling: unknown layout names error honestly and list the available names. Side effects: read-only.
tool.gps_nav_decode.description: GPS LNAV navigation-message subframe decode: 300-bit subframe x (10 words x 30 bits) -> TLM/HOW validation + parity check + ephemeris/clock parameter extraction (subframes 1/2/3). Precondition: bits are a 0/1 list whose length is a multiple of 300 (produced upstream by the demodulation chain). Failure handling: TLM preamble mismatch / parity failure / incomplete subframe set all report the exact word index and bit offset — no fabricated ephemeris is produced. Side effects: pure computation. Capability boundary: message layer only (no DLL/PLL tracking loops).
tool.gps_ephemeris_satpos.description: Ephemeris -> satellite ECEF position/velocity: Kepler iteration + harmonic perturbations + orbital-plane rotation, using public WGS-84 physical constants. Input is the ephemeris output of gps_nav_decode. Failure handling: out-of-range eccentricity or non-convergent Kepler iteration errors honestly. Side effects: pure computation.
tool.gps_pvt_solve.description: Pseudorange least-squares PVT: >=4 satellite pseudoranges + satellite positions -> receiver ECEF position + receiver clock bias (explicit convergence criteria; GDOP and residuals reported honestly). Failure handling: fewer than 4 satellites, ill-conditioned geometry, or non-convergence errors honestly — no position is produced. Side effects: pure computation. Capability boundary: no velocity estimation (Doppler FDT deferred).
tool.array_correlator_df.description: Single-station array direction finding: K-element simultaneous complex-baseband snapshots -> correlation matrix -> steering-vector azimuth sweep -> bearing. Multi-peak/grating-lobe ambiguity is exposed explicitly (when the secondary peak is within 3 dB of the main peak, no single bearing is reported — only the peak list). Preconditions: snapshots (K x N complex), freq_hz, element_positions_m (K x 2 / K x 3 ENU coordinates in meters). Side effects: pure computation. Capability boundary: narrowband plane-wave assumption; does not resolve coherent multipath (which would require spatial smoothing / decorrelation).
tool.multistation_tdoa_fix.description: Multistation TDOA localization: >=3 station coordinates + delay differences relative to a reference station -> hyperbolic least squares -> emitter planar position (with GDOP/residuals). Fewer than 3 stations, non-convergence, or residuals over threshold error honestly — no position is produced. Preconditions: stations_m (M x 2 meters), tdoa_s (seconds, length = number of stations). Side effects: pure computation. Capability boundary: 2D planar localization; 3D requires inter-station height differences or elevation observations (not in this tool).
tool.tc_build_frame.description: Build a CCSDS TC telecommand frame: data + 6-byte header (SCID/VCID/length/sequence count) + CRC16-CCSDS. Layout is injected from frame_layouts.json (default ccsds_tc_classic). Field value-domain violations raise errors — no silent truncation. Pure computation, no side effects; the product is used for cross-checking with tc_frame_parse and by the uplink chain.
tool.tc_frame_parse.description: Parse a CCSDS TC frame: header fields + data + CRC16-CCSDS check. A length field inconsistent with the total size, or a CRC failure, is reported/marked honestly — no fabricated normal frame is produced.
tool.pcm_psk_pm_modulate.description: PCM/PSK/PM modulation: bits -> NRZ (L/M/S) -> PSK subcarrier -> PM carrier, output complex baseband. All parameters named (sample rate / code rate / subcarrier / modulation index); inconsistent parameters (subcarrier above Nyquist, sps < 4) raise errors. Pure computation, no side effects.
tool.tc_uplink_transmit.description: TC uplink transmission (**write/actuate tool, arm_manual human gate**): without explicit arm_manual=true it is always GATED; armed but no usable transmit device honestly reports NEED_HW; missing frequency is PARAM_ERROR (safety-critical parameters are never guessed). It never claims a successful transmission without passing the gate or connecting a device.
tool.verify_decode_chain.description: Protocol-level decode verification chain: bit stream -> layout-table sync-word frame splitting -> layout-table CRC check -> per-field extraction -> assertion-list evaluation, item by item (acceptance spine). Any step failure errors honestly with no half-baked conclusions; layout honesty annotations pass through. Swapping satellites or layouts only changes frame_layouts.json / sat_profiles.json — this tool has zero hardcoding. Preconditions: bits (post-demodulation bit stream), layout_name. Side effects: pure computation.
tool.bch_generator.description: BCH generator-polynomial derivation (clean room): GF(2^m) is computed on the fly from the primitive polynomial, g(x) = product of minimal polynomials of alpha^1..alpha^{2t}, zero dependence on standard tables. Returns n/k/t/designed distance. Defaults m=8, t=8 (BCH(255,223) textbook parameters). Capability boundary: BCH in the narrow sense; DVB-S2 frame-format tables wait for the standard text, then go through configuration injection.
tool.bch_encode.description: BCH systematic encoding: k information bits -> n-bit codeword (information first).
tool.bch_decode.description: BCH decoding (Berlekamp-Massey + Chien search): corrects up to t errors guaranteed; beyond t errors it reports uncorrectable honestly — never outputs a fabricated valid-looking codeword.
tool.vna_list_ports.description: Enumerate NanoVNA serial ports (USB VID:PID hint filter). Read-only; returns an honest empty list when pyserial or the device is absent - never fabricates ports. Returns [(port, vid, pid), ...].
tool.vna_sweep.description: Full NanoVNA sweep (device-touching tool): connects, captures S11/S21 plus derived trace formats, and attaches one-port/two-port analysis (VSWR extrema, resonance, TDR, LC match, two-port gain). Fails honestly (NEED_HW) with no device - never fabricates measurement data. Auto-segments when points exceed the device single-sweep limit.
tool.vna_analyze.description: Pure-compute analysis (no device) on caller-provided S-parameters: one-port (VSWR, resonance Q, TDR, LC match, cable loss) and optional two-port (gain/group delay). Input must come from real measurements (vna_sweep output) or be explicitly labeled synthetic.
